svg.title: Step 7 mockup 22: Sign-up nudges: closing soon, remind me, last call, ask to join, overlap
svg.text: 22 · Sign-up nudges: closing soon, Remind me, last call, ask to join, overlap
Use case: several sessions a day, and nobody misses one by accident. Everything sits on the My sessions list of sheet 21. Demo names only.
2 · The reminder, and Ask to join
3 · Last call: hall screen, hub, Discord

g.text: Tap a row to join. The bell sets a reminder.
⚠ Demo Party and Demo Kart cup overlap
You asked for a reminder and have not joined.
The crew has your request. If they add you,
you get a push. Ask once.
One tap adds Pike through the normal register

svg.text: Hall screen · Next up with last call
Shows on the hub from 30 min before the close
Last call: Demo Racer time trial closes 21:00
Mentions are off; only the tournament link is in the post.
PC: the same bell, the same line on hover

g.text: We'll remind you 30 min before sign-up closes
The line shows the first time the button is pressed, and on hover.

svg.text: The closing chip sits on its own line from 30 minutes before a close. The bell button (Remind me) sends
one reminder 30 minutes before sign-up closes, only for a session you have not joined; sessions without
The line "We'll remind you 30 min before sign-up closes" shows the first time the button is pressed and
Ask to join works on a closed session and goes to the crew queue; reopening registration (sheet 20)
stays the way to open a session to everyone.
The overlap warning shows only where two ticked sessions overlap; it is a warning, never a block. Last
call goes to the hall screen, the hub and a Discord post.
